node.title: DSP8 nodal Stepanov constant barrier
node.statement: Every positive parameter choice in the in-house one-auxiliary-polynomial Stepanov ansatz, with D(A+D)<AB^2 and AB<=m, has degree-to-multiplicity quotient greater than 2^(5/3)m^(2/3). Using this ansatz for both the order-n quotient line and order-3n nodal parameter count forces a class-blind leading coefficient above 2176, exceeding the live G-normalized allowance 48536/25. Retuning A,B,D cannot close the three-cubic-root nodal lane. Mattarei's distinct Garcia--Voloch route now bypasses this proof-method barrier; the statement was never a lower bound on actual records.
